title: Switching from clarinet to drums with Kid Howard's help
summary: He tried clarinet, tired of holding it up, and learned drums with Kid Howard, who took him on jobs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: How come you wanted to take up drums? I mean, it's a natural instrument to take up, but most of the real young boys, you know, they all want to play drums.
Yeah, well, I'll tell you. I first started with clarinet. Oh, really?

Yeah. But I'd get tired holding it up in there. So, yeah. So I'd decide that I'd learn to take up drums. Learn drums. Well, at the time of learning the drums, Kit Howard used to come by and Howard, well, he tried to show me a lot of it.
Well, he'd been playing drums, hadn't he?

He had been playing drums, yeah. Yeah, and he tried to like me. And by me and him being good friends, he took me on a little job where he could get by with me. And then after he got me down, I'd come and say, be good on the drums, good as the bank fella. I played all the job he played. Plum up, tell the last of 43 when I left and came up here.
